rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a soothing or healing ointment, cream, or balm.

example.english: This salve will quickly reduce the redness and swelling on my elbow.
example.traditional: 呢支藥膏搽落去，手踭啲紅腫好快就退。
example.jyutping: ne1 zi1 joek6 gou1 caa4 lok6 heoi3 sau2 zaang1 di1 hung4 zung2 hou2 faai3 zau6 teoi3

rows.note: Use this for emotional or psychological relief, such as forgiveness being a comfort to someone’s conscience.

example.english: His willingness to forgive me was a real salve for my conscience.
example.traditional: 佢肯原諒我，對我個良心真係一種安慰。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hang2 jyun4 loeng6 ngo5 deoi3 ngo5 go3 loeng4 sam1 zan1 hai6 jat1 zung2 on1 wai3

rows.note: Use this when presenting something, often metaphorically, as a healing remedy rather than simply emotional comfort.

example.english: Exercise is a salve for the stress of city dwellers.
example.traditional: 運動係醫治都市人壓力嘅良藥。
example.jyutping: wan6 dung6 hai6 ji1 zi6 dou1 si5 jan4 aat3 lik6 ge3 loeng4 joek6
